takeaways: The Power Apps component framework lets developers build custom code components that behave like any other control in model-driven apps, canvas apps and Power Pages.
Building a code component is real developer work with a manifest, lifecycle methods, TypeScript, the Power Platform CLI and packaging into a Dataverse solution.
Use PCF only when standard controls or canvas components cannot do the job, and plan for ownership and maintenance before a custom control becomes a black box.
hook: Every Power Apps maker eventually hits a wall where the standard controls are not enough. This episode explains the Power Apps component framework in plain English for makers, business users and aspiring developers: what code components are, how they work and when they are worth the effort. You will learn to spot the limits early and plan custom controls without creating fragile apps.
